hero.title: Five players. One lobby.
hero.description: LobbyTwoZero was born from the shared passion of five developers who love playing games. We set out to bring game discovery, player communities, friendships and hardware experiences together in one place.

paragraphs.one: Everything about gaming usually lives in different places: discovering games in one, finding friends and teammates in another, and wondering whether your hardware can run a game somewhere else entirely.
paragraphs.two: We wanted to bring these pieces together in a single lobby. Each of us takes on a different area while building one shared product.
paragraphs.three: LobbyTwoZero is currently in development. What we describe here are our goals, and not all of it is live yet.

Faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.description: Find answers to your questions about LobbyTwoZero here.

whatIs.title: What is LobbyTwoZero?
whatIs.answer: LobbyTwoZero (LTZ) is a social gaming platform being built for players. It aims to bring game discovery, player communities, friendships and hardware experiences together in one place. The project is in development and features are added step by step.

purpose.title: Why is LTZ being built?
purpose.answer: LTZ is being built to make it easier to find what to play, who to play with and how your computer might run a game, all in one place. The goal is to gather these needs in a single lobby instead of spreading them across different sites.

availability.title: Is the platform available right now?
availability.answer: The platform is not fully live yet. The general interface and information pages are ready, while modules such as games, social features and hardware tools are still in development. Items marked “Soon” in the menu are features that are not open yet.

accountRequired.title: Do I need an account to use LTZ?
accountRequired.answer: You do not need an account to browse general pages such as About and FAQ. Personal features such as profile, library and messaging are planned to require an account. The account system is not live yet, so you do not need to sign in right now.

createAccount.title: How can I create an account?
createAccount.answer: Account creation is in development and not available yet. Sign-up and sign-in steps will be announced on this page when they are ready. Until then, do not trust fake sign-up pages or messages that ask for an account in LTZ's name.

steamGoogle.title: Can I sign in with Steam or Google?
steamGoogle.answer: Sign-in with Steam and Google is planned, but it is not available yet. When account linking arrives, it is designed so that an account is only linked with your consent.

editProfile.title: How can I edit my profile and player preferences?
editProfile.answer: Editing your profile and player preferences is planned together with the account system. It is not live yet, so there is no profile to edit right now. For now, the only things you can change are the appearance, language and navigation preferences on the Settings page, which are stored on this device only.

deleteAccount.title: Can I delete my account and personal data?
deleteAccount.answer: Deleting your account and personal data is a right planned to be offered with the account system. The deletion is intended to require identity verification and explicit confirmation. Details such as how long data is kept will be set out in the privacy notices.

discoverGames.title: Which games can I discover on LTZ?
discoverGames.answer: Game discovery is one of LTZ's core goals. We aim to let you browse games by genre, platform and community feedback. This section is not live yet, so there is no game catalog at the moment.

libraryFavorites.title: How can I manage my favorite games and my library?
libraryFavorites.answer: Adding games you like to your favorites and personal library is among the planned features. My Library will open once the game and account systems are ready; for now it appears as “Soon” in the menu.

ratingsReviews.title: Can I rate games and write reviews?
ratingsReviews.answer: Rating games and writing reviews is planned. It is not live yet, so no ratings or reviews are shown at the moment. Any ratings shown in the future are intended to be based on real user contributions.

filterGames.title: Can I filter games by genre and platform?
filterGames.answer: Filtering by genre and platform is a feature intended to arrive with the game catalog. Since the catalog is not live yet, filters are not available at the moment.

friends.title: How can I make friends on LTZ?
friends.answer: Adding friends and a friends list are planned. These features depend on the account system, so they are not available yet; when ready, they will be reachable from the Friends item in the menu.

messaging.title: Can I message other players?
messaging.answer: Messaging your friends is among the targeted features. Messaging is not live yet; when it arrives, it is planned to ship together with privacy and safety settings.

findTeam.title: What is the Find a Team feature?
findTeam.answer: Find a Team is a feature designed to help you find players to play with. The aim is for you to post a listing for a game and join other people's listings. It is not live yet.

communityPosts.title: How will community posts work?
communityPosts.answer: The Community section is planned to let players share posts and interact with each other. It is not live yet, so there are no community posts to view at the moment.

eventsTournaments.title: Can I join events and tournaments?
eventsTournaments.answer: Listing events and tournaments is a goal. This section is not open yet; when it goes live, details about how to take part will be updated on this page.

addHardware.title: How can I add my hardware details?
addHardware.answer: Hardware details are designed to be entered manually: you will pick and add components such as the processor, graphics card and memory, and the brand will not be mandatory. Automatically scanning your computer is not part of the first release. This feature is not live yet.

multipleProfiles.title: Can I create more than one computer profile?
multipleProfiles.answer: The aim is for you to save different systems, such as a desktop and a laptop, as separate computer profiles. This feature is not live yet.

fpsCompatibility.title: How do estimated FPS and compatibility work?
fpsCompatibility.answer: The aim is to offer an estimated FPS and compatibility indication of how a game might run on the hardware you enter. These values are estimates, not measurements, and will be labeled as such. The feature is not live yet, and no FPS value is shown at the moment.

ltzPerformance.title: What is LTZ Performance?
ltzPerformance.answer: LTZ Performance is the name of the module set aside for hardware and game performance experiences, and it is not live yet. A browser cannot measure processor or graphics card temperature or FPS. Such measurements could only be possible with a desktop app planned for later, which is not part of the first release.

recommendations.title: How will personal recommendations work?
recommendations.answer: Personal recommendations aim to show games that fit your hardware and gaming preferences. They are designed to be produced by a rule and data based algorithm, not a chatbot. The feature is not live yet.

accountSecurity.title: How will my account be kept secure?
accountSecurity.answer: Security is a core part of the design. What you are allowed to do is intended to be decided on the server side, so seeing a screen alone never means you have permission. Details will appear in the Privacy Policy once the account system goes live.

twoFactor.title: Will there be two-factor authentication?
twoFactor.answer: Two-factor authentication is planned, but it is not available yet. Supported methods and setup steps will be announced on this page once the account system is ready.

visibility.title: Who will be able to see my profile and hardware details?
visibility.answer: You will be able to choose who sees your profile and hardware details; per-field visibility settings are planned. They are not live yet, so these settings are not available at the moment.

reporting.title: How can I report inappropriate content or users?
reporting.answer: Reporting inappropriate content and users, along with content moderation, is planned. This mechanism is not live yet; once it is, how it works will be explained in the Terms of Use.
